claim: information_schema TABLE_TYPE is 'BASE TABLE' for base tables and TABLE_NAME/COLUMN_NAME are returned with their stored case, so case-sensitive comparison detects letter-case mismatch (criterion 6), including under lower_case_table_names

Case-sensitive comparison therefore flags a case mismatch for tables and columns (criterion 6). Under lower_case_table_names=1 MySQL stores and reports table names in lowercase, so a listed mixed-case table is flagged. That is conservative, and the stored case is what the comparison sees. Column names keep their case under every setting. The check connects through pymysql (_check_catalog_blocking, :531-538) with default charset, which returns str for these non-binary columns. claim: test_stored_function_on_a_listed_column_is_refused expects RlsError from the function denylist with no [[rls]] rules configured, i.e. the function check runs in a runner present in _chain without rls

claim: _toml_value serializes a datetime.date as a bare TOML date and every other value as valid TOML; a datetime.datetime (subclass of date) is also emitted via isoformat
verify_hint: Trace a datetime.datetime value and a dict key needing quoting through _toml_value
evidence: tests/unit/_rule_set_fixtures.py:81-94. bool -> true/false; int/float -> repr (valid TOML numbers, incl. nan/inf and 1e+16); isinstance(value, datetime.date) at line 86 returns isoformat(), so a date yields a bare TOML date (2026-11-01) and a datetime.datetime, being a date subclass, also hits that branch and gives a TOML datetime such as 2026-01-02T03:04:05. str -> json.dumps (valid TOML basic string for BMP text); list -> inline array; dict -> inline table. The date branch is placed after the bool/number checks and before str, so ordering is fine. Caveat: inline-table keys (line 93) and root keys (line 99) are emitted unquoted, so a key containing spaces or dots would not be valid TOML. I grepped the callers' documents (tests/unit/_rule_set_fixtures.py and test_rule_set_file.py) and found only bare-identifier keys, so no input from a caller reaches that case. Keys are also not 'values' as the claim words it.
